text:
Looks like chunks of white cheese or egg whites (possibly cheese curds or fresh cheese) with green salsa and sausage/fried sweet potato pieces on a square plate.

Estimate: white chunks ~150 g. If it's panela or mozzarella-type cheese, that's about 250 kcal per 100 g, so around 375 kcal. If it's egg whites, it would be far less. The texture looks like crumbled fresh cheese or chopped hard-boiled egg white. I'll take a middle estimate.

Salsa verde: ~60 g, ~25 kcal.
Sausage/sweet potato pieces: ~60 g, ~130 kcal.
White chunks: ~150 g, ~300 kcal.

Total: ~270 g, ~455 kcal.

{"kcal": 450, "mass_g": 270}
